Name: Named place
Description: A part of a room with a name of its own, such as a flight of stairs or a landing: a box that says where you are as you walk into it, and nothing else. It is not a room. An acoustic_region is both a name and a room for sound, and cutting a stairwell into rooms a flight long would cut its sound into pieces too; a named place inside a room changes the name you hear and leaves the room, its reverberation and its openings exactly as they were. Where it overlaps a room the named place is the name; the smallest wins where named places overlap. Scale it to the space it names. Not solid, not a surface, not read out as a thing near you.
